sloka: सर्वे ऽपि जन्तवो ऽन्योन्यं भेतव्ये सति बिभ्यति ।अतो ऽत्र लोके सर्वेषां सर्वस्माच्च भवेद्भयम् ।। ७.३०.१० ॥
transliteration: sarve 'pi jantavo 'nyonyaṁ bhetavye sati bibhyati ।ato 'tra loke sarveṣāṁ sarvasmācca bhavedbhayam ।। 7.30.10 ॥

translations.english: All living beings fear each other when there is cause for fear, and thus in this world, everyone may experience fear from everything.
